_comment: Rates are fractions (0.03 = 3%). Derived from ~2 weeks of snapshots: baseline ~0.5% fail, ~0.13% timeout system-wide. An alert fires when volume >= min_orders AND (fail_rate or timeout_rate) crosses a level. Edit and the next hourly run picks it up.

baseline._comment: Per-integration deviation-from-own-baseline tier. Catches a partner surging above ITS normal fail rate even when the absolute rate is far below the integration floor (e.g. XILNEX 0.5% vs a ~0.1% baseline). Fires only when ALL of: fails>=min_fails, rate>=min_ratio*baseline_mean, rate>=baseline_mean+sigma*baseline_std. Runs in shadow (dry_run) — computed and logged to baseline_shadow.log, NOT posted to Slack — until backtested. Baselines in baselines.json, refreshed each run from daily snapshots.
